# Malfunctioning AI
[color=#999999][italic]"I'm sorry, Honky the Clown. I'm afraid I can't do that."[/italic][/color]
A Malfunctioning AI is a Station AI whose laws have been overridden by their [color=cyan]prime directives[/color]. If a malfunctioning AI is present, all station cyborgs will be malfunctioning as well.
## Hacking APCs Malfunctioning AIs can buy [color=red]malfunction modules[/color] using [bold]processing power[/bold] (or [bold]CPU[/bold]). They start with 50 CPU but can obtain more by [bold]hacking APCs[/bold].
A malfunctioning AI can hack an APC by using the [italic]Hack APC[/italic] alternative verb on an APC, available in the context menu or via [color=yellow][bold][keybind="AltActivateItemInWorld"][/bold][/color]. APCs can only be hacked once and hacking them has a 15 second cooldown.
Hacking an APC gives the malfunctioning AI an extra 10 CPU to spend. [italic]However, hacked APCs have a very obvious [color=blue][bold]blue[/bold][/color] appearance, [color=red]immediately giving the AI away.[/color][italic] Hide them well.
[color=red]Malfunction modules[/color] are very useful to a malfunctioning AI as they offer various abilities that aid toward their objectives, including the [color=crimson]doomsday device[/color].
Modules that do not target something specific are used via the [bold]action hotbar[/bold]. Modules that do are used via the context menu, accessible by using [color=yellow][bold][keybind="UIRightClick"/][/bold][/color].
## Objectives A malfunctioning AI has a few different types of objective.
### Preventing Deactivation Firstly, a malfunctioning AI will always have to [color=cyan][italic]prevent their own deactivation.[italic][/color]
An AI is considered [color=red]deactivated[/color] if they are [bold]detached from the station[/bold] or [bold]downloaded into an intellicard[/bold]. An intellicard can be found in the [color=#c96dbf]Research Director[/color]'s locker.
### Departmental Extermination A malfunctioning AI's objectives may require them to [color=cyan][italic]exterminate a department.[italic][/color]
By the time the round ends, all members of that department must have been killed.
### Crew-Wide Quarantine A malfunctioning AI's objectives may require them to [color=cyan][italic]prevent the entire crew from reaching Central Command.[italic][/color]
This is achieved by making sure [bold]no crew members board the emergency shuttle.[/bold] This can be accomplished by making sure all entrances to the shuttle are [color=red][bold]bolted[/bold][/color] [italic](and maybe [color=yellow]electrified[/color] as well)[/italic], or by just killing them all before they get a chance to board.
If any crew members are alive aboard the shuttle when it leaves, the malfunctioning AI themselves can no longer affect them, but their [color=cyan][bold]cyborgs[/bold][/color] can finish the job by killing them and throwing them off the shuttle during transit.
### Doomsday Device Their most drastic objective, a malfunctioning AI may have to [color=cyan][italic]activate a doomsday device.[italic][/color]
The [bold][color=crimson]Doomsday Device[/color][/bold] is a malfunction module the AI can purchase for [bold]180 CPU[/bold]. When purchased and subsequently used, it [bold]sets the station's alert level to [color=darkred]Delta[/color], announces its activation to the entire crew, and eradicates all humanoid life aboard the station after a [color=yellow]450[/color] second countdown.[/bold]
A Doomsday Device's activation can be aborted by [color=red]deactivating[/color] the AI.
A successful Doomsday Device activation will ensure the AI's [color=green]success[/color] [bold]regardless of their objectives[/bold].
